desc: My little brother ___ seven years old.
explain: 主詞 My little brother 是第三人稱單數，be 動詞要用 is。

desc: This is my aunt. ___ name is Lily.
explain: aunt 是阿姨，表示她的名字，使用 Her。

desc: Look at the picture. There is ___ elephant.
explain: elephant 以母音發音開頭，單數可數名詞前使用 an。

desc: There ___ two chairs beside the table.
explain: two chairs 是複數，表示某處有兩張椅子時使用 There are。

desc: Sophie ___ to school every morning.
explain: every morning 表示習慣性動作，Sophie 是第三人稱單數，使用 walks。

desc: I ___ like onions, so I never put them in my sandwich.
explain: 主詞 I 搭配一般動詞 like，否定形式為 don't like。

desc: A: ___ do you go to school? B: By bus.
explain: By bus 說明交通方式，因此應使用 How 詢問怎麼去學校。

desc: 🎧 聽指令，杯子應該放在哪裡？
speak: Put the cup under the table.
explain: under the table 表示在桌子下面。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，是誰正在準備晚餐？
speak: My father is cooking dinner.
explain: father 是爸爸，句子表示爸爸正在煮晚餐。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，現在的天氣如何？
speak: It's raining. Take your umbrella.
explain: It's raining 表示正在下雨，所以需要帶雨傘。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，說話的人會做什麼？
speak: I can swim, but I can't ride a bike.
explain: can swim 表示會游泳；can't ride a bike 表示不會騎腳踏車。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，商店幾點開門？
speak: The shop opens at nine in the morning.
explain: nine in the morning 是上午九點。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，說話的人想喝什麼？
speak: I'd like some water, please.
explain: I'd like some water 表示想要一些水。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，到紅綠燈時應該怎麼走？
speak: Turn right at the traffic light.
explain: Turn right 表示向右轉，at the traffic light 是在紅綠燈處。

desc: 請唸出：家庭
speak: family

desc: 請唸出：老師
speak: teacher

desc: 請唸出：早餐
speak: breakfast

desc: 請唸出：星期一
speak: monday

desc: 請拼出：鉛筆
speak: pencil

desc: 請拼出：花園
speak: garden

desc: 填空題：F R I _ N D (朋友)
speak: friend

desc: 填空題：S C H _ O L (學校)
speak: school

desc: Yesterday, Nina ___ her keys on the bus. She couldn't get into her house.
explain: Yesterday 表示過去時間，lose 的過去式是 lost。

desc: Look! The children ___ in the park right now.
explain: Look 和 right now 表示動作正在發生，複數主詞搭配 are playing。

desc: I can carry your bag, but this suitcase is ___ than mine.
explain: than 表示兩者比較，heavy 的比較級是 heavier。

desc: There isn't ___ rice left in the pot. We need to cook some more.
explain: rice 是不可數名詞，否定句中表示剩下不多可用 much。

desc: You ___ show your ticket before entering the concert hall. It's required.
explain: It's required 表示這是規定，must 用來表達必須遵守的義務。

point: be going to for planned future
desc: We ___ visit our grandparents this weekend. We've already made plans.
explain: 已經安排好的未來計畫，可用 be going to 加原形動詞。

desc: Of all the students in the basketball team, Mia is the ___.
explain: Of all the students 表示在整個群體中比較，使用最高級 tallest。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，說話的人昨天為什麼待在家裡？
speak: I was sick, so I stayed home yesterday.
explain: I was sick 表示生病了，so 說明因此待在家裡。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，博物館星期幾不開放？
speak: The museum is closed on Mondays.
explain: closed on Mondays 表示每個星期一不開放。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，最晚星期幾要還書？
speak: Please return this book by Friday.
explain: by Friday 表示最晚星期五之前或當天要完成。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，顧客想向店員拿什麼？
speak: Could I have a receipt, please?
explain: receipt 是收據，Could I have... 是禮貌的請求方式。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，他們在動物園待了多久？
speak: We spent two hours at the zoo.
explain: spent two hours 表示花了兩個小時。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，電影幾點開始？
speak: The movie starts at quarter past seven.
explain: quarter past seven 表示七點過十五分，也就是 7:15。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，旅途中需要做什麼？
speak: We need to change trains at Central Station.
explain: change trains 表示轉乘火車，at Central Station 指轉車的地點。

desc: 請唸出這句：Could you speak more slowly?
speak: could you speak more slowly

desc: 請唸出這句：I am looking for the station.
ans: I AM LOOKING FOR THE STATION
speak: i am looking for the station

desc: 請唸出這句：Let's meet after lunch.
speak: let's meet after lunch

point: expressing a need for medical help
desc: 請唸出這句：I need to see a doctor.
ans: I NEED TO SEE A DOCTOR
speak: i need to see a doctor

desc: 請拼出：決定（動詞）
speak: decide

desc: 請拼出：不同的
speak: different

desc: 填空題：A R R I _ E D (抵達了)
speak: arrived

desc: 填空題：E X P E N S _ V E (昂貴的)
speak: expensive

desc: A: I forgot my notebook. B: Don't worry, I ___ you mine.
explain: 說話者當下決定提供幫助，可使用 will lend 表達即時提出的幫忙。

desc: Your ankle still hurts. You ___ rest for a few days before playing football again. This is my advice.
explain: should 用來提出建議。這裡是在建議對方讓腳踝休息幾天。

desc: Mia arrives ten minutes before class every day. She is ___ late.
explain: Mia 每天都提早到教室，因此 never late 表示從不遲到。

desc: The suitcase was ___ heavy for Leo to lift alone, so he asked his brother for help.
explain: too + 形容詞 + for someone + to V 表示對某人來說太過於某種程度，以致無法完成動作。

desc: Both walking routes take twenty minutes. This path is ___ the other one.
explain: as long as 表示兩者長度相同。兩條路都需要二十分鐘，符合相等比較。

desc: This glass bowl breaks easily. Please carry it ___.
explain: carefully 表示小心地。易碎的玻璃碗需要小心搬運，而不是粗魯或不小心地拿取。

desc: The library closes at six. You can study here ___ six, but you must leave when it closes.
explain: until 表示直到某個時間為止。可以在圖書館待到六點，但關門時必須離開。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，見面時間有什麼改變？
speak: Let's meet at four instead of three. I have a doctor's appointment.
explain: instead of three 表示不在三點見面，改成四點，因此延後一小時。

point: changing transport because of icy roads
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，說話的人最後決定怎麼去？
speak: I planned to cycle, but the road is icy. I'll take the train instead.
explain: 原本打算騎腳踏車，但路面結冰，因此改搭火車。

point: do not have to for lack of necessity
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，旅客需要自己帶毛巾嗎？
speak: You don't have to bring towels. The hotel provides them.
options: B. 不用帶，旅館會提供
D. 只有週末才需要帶
explain: don't have to 表示不需要，旅館已經提供毛巾。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，這件便宜外套有什麼缺點？
speak: This jacket is cheaper, but it isn't waterproof. I'll keep looking.
explain: isn't waterproof 表示不防水。雖然價格較便宜，但說話的人仍想繼續找。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，關閉程式之前應該先做什麼？
speak: First save the file, then close the program.
explain: First save the file 表示先儲存檔案，then close 表示之後再關閉程式。

point: alternative access to a sold out concert
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，買不到現場門票的人還能怎麼做？
speak: The concert is sold out, but you can still watch it online.
options: D. 改看另一場演唱會
explain: sold out 表示售完，但 still watch it online 表示仍然可以在線上觀看。

point: contrasting weekday and weekend food habits
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，說話的人平日比較喜歡吃什麼？
speak: I eat meat on weekends, but I prefer vegetables on weekdays.
explain: on weekdays 表示平日，prefer vegetables 表示比較喜歡蔬菜。

desc: 請唸出這句：Could you help me carry this bag?
ans: COULD YOU HELP ME CARRY THIS BAG
speak: could you help me carry this bag

desc: 請唸出這句：We are meeting outside the station.
ans: WE ARE MEETING OUTSIDE THE STATION
speak: we are meeting outside the station

desc: 請唸出這句：I forgot to bring my umbrella.
ans: I FORGOT TO BRING MY UMBRELLA
speak: i forgot to bring my umbrella

desc: 請唸出這句：The weather is getting colder today.
ans: THE WEATHER IS GETTING COLDER TODAY
speak: the weather is getting colder today

desc: 請拼出：邀請（動詞）
speak: invite

desc: 請拼出：行李
speak: luggage

desc: 填空題：A P P O I N T M _ N T (預約)
speak: appointment

desc: 填空題：D I R E C _ I O N (方向)
speak: direction

desc: I've visited Kyoto twice, but I've never ___ to Osaka.
explain: 現在完成式 have never been to 表示從未去過某個地方，適合描述人生經驗。

desc: Maya has worked at this café ___ 2021. She still works there today.
explain: since 接時間起點，例如 since 2021；for 則接持續時間，例如 for five years。

desc: If the roads ___ icy tonight, the school will close tomorrow.
explain: 第一類條件句通常使用 If + 現在簡單式，主句使用 will + 原形動詞。

desc: The bridge ___ in 1998, and it still carries traffic today.
explain: 橋是被建造的，且時間是 1998 年，因此使用過去簡單被動式 was built。

desc: When my grandfather was young, he ___ walk ten kilometers to school.
explain: used to + 原形動詞表示過去經常做、現在不一定還在做的習慣。

desc: ___ she was nervous, she gave a clear and confident presentation.
explain: Although 表示雖然，呈現緊張與表現清楚自信之間的轉折。

desc: Excuse me, could you tell me where ___?
explain: 間接問句使用直述句語序：where + 主詞 + 動詞，因此是 where the bus stops。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，客人想請餐廳做什麼？
speak: I booked an outdoor table, but rain is expected. Could we sit inside instead?
explain: 原本訂了室外座位，但因為預報有雨，希望改坐室內。

point: missed connection due to train delay
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，說話的人為什麼遲到？
speak: The first train was delayed, so I missed my connection and arrived after the meeting started.
options: D. 第一班火車誤點，錯過轉車
explain: 第一班火車延誤，導致錯過轉乘列車，因此在會議開始後才抵達。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，說話的人對工作坊有什麼看法？
speak: I expected a boring workshop, but the practical exercises were surprisingly useful.
options: B. 活動完全沒有實作
C. 實作活動比預期有幫助
D. 工作坊太簡單，沒有收穫
explain: 原本預期很無聊，但 surprisingly useful 表示實作活動出乎意料地有幫助。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，什麼情況下不能線上續借圖書？
speak: You can renew library books online unless someone else has reserved them.
options: B. 已經有人預約該書
explain: unless 表示除非；如果已經有人預約該書，就不能線上續借。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，海報實際上是誰設計的？
speak: Sarah didn't design the poster herself. She asked her cousin to do it.
explain: Sarah 沒有親自設計海報，而是請她的 cousin（表親或堂親）完成。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，他們最後決定哪一天去健行？
speak: We planned to hike on Saturday, but the park is closed for repairs. We'll go on Sunday instead.
explain: 原本計畫星期六去，但因為公園整修關閉，改成星期日。

point: inferring remaining work from a dialogue
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，報告還差哪一步才能完成？
speak: A: Have you finished the report? B: Almost. I just need to check the figures.
explain: Almost 表示快完成了，check the figures 表示還需要核對報告中的數據。

desc: 請唸出這句：Please let me know your decision.
ans: PLEASE LET ME KNOW YOUR DECISION
speak: please let me know your decision

desc: 請唸出這句：I would rather take the later train.
ans: I WOULD RATHER TAKE THE LATER TRAIN
speak: i would rather take the later train

desc: 請唸出這句：We managed to finish before sunset.
ans: WE MANAGED TO FINISH BEFORE SUNSET
speak: we managed to finish before sunset

point: looking forward to a future event
desc: 請唸出這句：I am looking forward to our trip.
ans: I AM LOOKING FORWARD TO OUR TRIP
speak: i am looking forward to our trip

desc: 請拼出：推薦（動詞）
speak: recommend

desc: 請拼出：改善（動詞）
speak: improve

desc: 填空題：A C H I E _ E (達成)
speak: achieve

desc: 填空題：R E S P O N S I B _ E (負責任的)
speak: responsible

desc: I ___ dinner when the lights suddenly went out.
explain: 過去某個動作正在進行時，另一件事突然發生，使用過去進行式 was cooking。

desc: The photographer ___ camera was stolen reported the theft to the police.
explain: whose 表示所有關係，whose camera 指那位攝影師的相機。

desc: To prevent confusion, please avoid ___ the outdated version of the document.
explain: avoid 後面接動名詞 V-ing，因此使用 avoid using，表示避免使用舊版本。

desc: Emma went to the library ___ a quiet place to study.
explain: to find 是表示目的的不定詞，說明 Emma 去圖書館是為了找安靜的讀書地方。

desc: After five years of night shifts, Anna is used to ___ late at night.
explain: be used to + V-ing 表示已經習慣做某事，這裡指 Anna 已經習慣深夜工作。

desc: ___ the heavy traffic, we reached the airport on time.
explain: Despite 後面可以直接接名詞片語 the heavy traffic，表示儘管交通壅塞。

desc: The café ___ we first met has closed permanently.
explain: where 引導表示地點的關係子句，we first met 修飾前面的 café。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，對方做決定前還需要什麼？
speak: I don't dislike the proposal, but I need a clearer breakdown of the costs before deciding.
options: C. 更完整的人員名單
D. 更清楚的費用明細
explain: clearer breakdown of the costs 表示更清楚的費用明細。對方尚未做出最後決定。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，說話的人為什麼不方便參加？
speak: I'd love to join you, but the new schedule overlaps with my evening class.
options: A. 活動時間和晚上的課程衝突
explain: overlaps with my evening class 表示時間與晚上的課程重疊，因此無法方便地參加。

point: recognizing contrast between expectation and outcome
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，說話的人對這次面試有什麼感想？
speak: I expected a formal interview, but the manager was surprisingly friendly and relaxed.
options: B. 比預期更輕鬆友善
explain: 原本預期面試很正式，但 surprisingly friendly and relaxed 表示面試官意外地友善、放鬆。

point: inferring the cause of a delivery problem
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，包裹為什麼還沒送達？
speak: The driver reached our street, but the address on the package was incomplete.
options: C. 包裹上的地址不完整
D. 司機找不到停車位
explain: 司機已經抵達附近，但包裹上的地址不完整，因此無法順利送達。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，報告真正的截止時間是什麼時候？
speak: The email originally said Thursday, but the corrected deadline is Friday afternoon.
explain: 原本寫的是星期四，但 corrected deadline 指修正後的截止時間，即星期五下午。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，什麼情況下可以參加活動？
speak: You may join the workshop provided you register before Wednesday.
options: A. 星期三之前完成報名
B. 星期三當天直接到場
C. 帶一位朋友一起來
D. 曾經參加過工作坊
explain: provided 表示以某個條件為前提，必須在星期三之前完成報名。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，主管希望員工修改什麼？
speak: The introduction is fine, but please shorten the conclusion and add clearer examples.
options: B. 縮短結論並增加清楚的例子
explain: 前言沒有問題；主管希望縮短結論，並增加更清楚的例子。

desc: 請唸出這句：I would prefer to travel by train.
ans: I WOULD PREFER TO TRAVEL BY TRAIN
speak: i would prefer to travel by train

desc: 請唸出這句：Could you explain what the instructions mean?
ans: COULD YOU EXPLAIN WHAT THE INSTRUCTIONS MEAN
speak: could you explain what the instructions mean

desc: 請唸出這句：I'm not sure whether it's available.
ans: I'M NOT SURE WHETHER IT'S AVAILABLE
speak: i'm not sure whether it's available

point: expressing regret about a past action
desc: 請唸出這句：I regret leaving my umbrella behind.
ans: I REGRET LEAVING MY UMBRELLA BEHIND
speak: i regret leaving my umbrella behind

desc: 請拼出：環境
speak: environment

desc: 請拼出：機會
speak: opportunity

desc: 填空題：C O N F I D E N _ (有自信的)
speak: confident

desc: 填空題：P E R M I S S _ O N (許可)
speak: permission

desc: It was the first time Elena ___ such a difficult decision without asking anyone for advice.
explain: It was the first time 後面通常使用過去完成式 had faced，表示截至過去某個時刻第一次經歷某事。

desc: If I ___ in charge of the department, I would allow more flexible working hours.
explain: 第二類條件句表達與現在事實不同的假設，使用 If + 過去式，主句搭配 would + 原形動詞。正式用法常使用 If I were。

desc: If we had left earlier, we ___ the last ferry instead of spending the night at the harbor.
explain: 第三類條件句表示與過去事實相反的假設：If + had + 過去分詞，主句使用 would have + 過去分詞。

desc: The security officer warned us ___ our passwords with strangers.
explain: warn someone not to do something 表示警告某人不要做某事。否定不定詞形式為 not to share。

desc: The office is empty, and everyone's coats are gone. They ___ left for the day.
explain: must have + 過去分詞表示根據證據推測過去很可能已經發生的事情。

point: wish past perfect for past regrets
desc: I wish I ___ the agreement more carefully before signing it.
explain: wish + had + 過去分詞表示對過去已發生、無法改變的事情感到後悔。

desc: The newly discovered painting ___ to be over four hundred years old.
explain: is believed to be 表示據信是某種情況，使用被動式表達普遍看法或專家推測。

point: conditional committee approval pending budget revision
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，提案獲得正式批准前還需要什麼？
speak: The committee hasn't rejected the proposal, but approval depends on a revised budget by Friday.
options: B. 星期五前提交修改後的預算
C. 重新設計整份提案
D. 取得所有客戶簽名
explain: 委員會尚未否決提案，但批准取決於星期五前是否提交修改後的預算。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，貨物無法準時交付的主要原因是什麼？
speak: Although delivery was promised on Monday, customs held the shipment until Thursday, making us miss the client's deadline.
options: A. 客戶臨時更改訂單
B. 工廠沒有準時生產
explain: customs held the shipment until Thursday 表示貨物被海關留置到星期四，導致錯過客戶的期限。

point: questioning an assumed cause using chronology
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，哪個資訊讓原本的故障原因受到質疑？
speak: We initially blamed the software update, but the failures had started several days before it was installed.
options: A. 更新費用超出預算
B. 軟體更新後增加了新功能
C. 所有設備都已經更換
D. 故障在軟體更新之前就發生了
explain: 故障早在安裝更新之前就開始，因此不能單純把故障歸因於此次更新。

point: contract renewal dependent on spare parts guarantee
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，什麼條件下公司才會續約？
speak: If the supplier can guarantee replacement parts, we'll renew the contract; otherwise, we'll consider alternatives.
options: A. 供應商保證提供替換零件
D. 供應商增加銷售人員
explain: 續約的條件是供應商能保證提供替換零件，否則公司會考慮其他選擇。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，面試官對候選人主要有什麼疑慮？
speak: The candidate had impressive qualifications, yet struggled to explain how her experience applied to this particular role.
options: B. 無法清楚說明經驗如何應用於職位
C. 沒有任何相關工作經驗
D. 拒絕回答薪資問題
explain: 候選人的資格很好，但無法清楚解釋自己的經驗如何實際應用於應徵的職務。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，活動安排實際上改變了什麼？
speak: A: Was the event postponed? B: No, it's still on Friday, but the venue has changed because the auditorium is being repaired.
options: C. 地點改變，日期不變
explain: 活動仍在星期五舉行，但因禮堂整修而更換地點，並沒有延期。

point: conditional project approval subject to privacy safeguards
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，專案正式開始收集資料之前必須完成什麼？
speak: The board approved the project in principle, provided the team addresses privacy risks before collecting customer data.
options: B. 增加資料蒐集範圍
C. 聘請額外的銷售人員
D. 處理客戶資料的隱私風險
explain: 董事會原則上同意專案，但正式蒐集客戶資料之前，團隊必須先處理隱私風險。

point: expressing the need for immediate action
desc: 請唸出這句：The problem needs to be addressed immediately.
ans: THE PROBLEM NEEDS TO BE ADDRESSED IMMEDIATELY
speak: the problem needs to be addressed immediately

desc: 請唸出這句：I'd appreciate it if you could clarify.
ans: I'D APPRECIATE IT IF YOU COULD CLARIFY
speak: i'd appreciate it if you could clarify

desc: 請唸出這句：The outcome was different from what we expected.
ans: THE OUTCOME WAS DIFFERENT FROM WHAT WE EXPECTED
speak: the outcome was different from what we expected

desc: 請唸出這句：We should consider the long-term consequences.
ans: WE SHOULD CONSIDER THE LONG-TERM CONSEQUENCES
speak: we should consider the long-term consequences

desc: 請拼出：談判（動詞）
speak: negotiate

desc: 請拼出：顯著的
speak: significant

desc: 填空題：I N E V I T A B _ E (不可避免的)
speak: inevitable

desc: 填空題：A C K N O W L E D G _ (承認)
speak: acknowledge

point: present perfect continuous for ongoing activity
desc: The technicians ___ the network continuously since dawn, but they still haven't identified the source of the problem.
explain: have been monitoring 是現在完成進行式，強調從過去持續到現在的活動。since dawn 表示從黎明開始，且目前仍在持續。

desc: The engineer admitted that ignoring the warning was a mistake. He said he ___ the warning more seriously.
explain: should have + 過去分詞表示過去本來應該做、實際卻沒做的事情，符合工程師承認犯錯的語境。

point: future perfect for completed future actions
desc: By the time the inspectors arrive next Monday, the engineers ___ all the required safety checks.
explain: will have completed 是未來完成式，表示在未來某個時間點之前，動作就已經完成。

point: perfect passive infinitive in reporting structures
desc: The results from last month's trial are believed ___ by an unnoticed calibration error.
explain: are believed to have been affected 表示據信過去曾受到影響。結果是被校準錯誤影響，因此需要完成式被動不定詞。

desc: The findings are based on a small preliminary study and may change after further testing. They should not be treated as ___.
explain: definitive 表示確定且具有決定性的。初步研究仍可能改變，因此不能視為最終定論。

desc: The museum has not canceled the exhibition. However, installation work is behind schedule, and a revised opening date will be announced next week. What can visitors conclude?
options: A. The exhibition has been permanently canceled.
B. The opening date is currently uncertain.
C. The exhibition will definitely open next week.
D. The exhibition has already opened to visitors.
explain: 展覽並未取消，但安裝工程落後，新的開幕日期尚未公布。因此能確定的是開幕日期仍不明朗。

desc: Customers may return unused products within fourteen days. Refunds cover the purchase price but exclude delivery charges. What happens when an eligible product is returned on day ten?
options: A. Both the product price and delivery charges are refunded.
B. Only the delivery charges are refunded.
C. The product price is refunded, excluding delivery charges.
D. No refund is available after the first week.
explain: 符合條件的商品可在十四天內退貨，但退款不包含運費。第十天退貨可退商品價款，不能退運費。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，說話的人對試行計畫的態度是什麼？
speak: I wouldn't say the pilot failed, but the results are too inconsistent to justify a wider rollout.
options: A. 試行計畫已完全成功，應立即擴大
B. 試行計畫徹底失敗，必須取消
C. 試行計畫已經證實沒有風險
D. 結果不夠一致，尚不適合擴大推行
explain: 說話者沒有直接認定試行計畫失敗，但認為結果不夠一致，無法支持進一步擴大實施。

point: written confirmation as a contractual condition
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，下訂單之前還需要什麼？
speak: We can go ahead with the order as long as the supplier confirms the revised warranty in writing.
options: A. 供應商以書面確認修改後的保固條件
B. 供應商同意延長交貨期限
C. 供應商先寄送免費樣品
D. 供應商降低產品的單價
explain: as long as 表示條件，in writing 表示以書面形式確認。因此必須先取得修改後保固條件的書面確認。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，哪些資料為什麼會遺失？
speak: Had the backup been activated, we wouldn't have lost those records.
options: A. 備份檔案本身已經損壞
B. 備份沒有啟動，導致紀錄遺失
C. 有人主動刪除了備份紀錄
D. 備份系統將資料傳送到錯誤位置
explain: Had the backup been activated 是省略 if 的過去假設，暗示備份實際上沒有啟動，因此紀錄遺失。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，為什麼現在不能做出明確結論？
speak: The figures look promising, although the sample is too small to support firm conclusions.
options: A. 研究數據全部遺失
B. 研究結果已經被證實錯誤
C. 樣本數量太少，無法支持確定結論
D. 研究尚未取得任何數據
explain: 雖然數據看起來有希望，但樣本太小，還不足以支持明確的研究結論。

point: bringing forward deadlines without reducing scope
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，主管要求團隊怎麼調整專案？
speak: The manager asked us to bring forward the deadline rather than reduce the scope of the project.
options: A. 延後期限並縮小專案範圍
B. 維持期限但增加工作內容
C. 縮小專案範圍並維持期限
D. 提前期限，但不縮小專案範圍
explain: bring forward the deadline 表示提前截止日期；rather than reduce the scope 表示不選擇縮小專案範圍。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，公司什麼情況下才會更換設備？
speak: We won't replace the equipment unless the second inspection confirms a fault.
options: A. 第二次檢查確認有故障
B. 第一次檢查沒有發現問題
C. 設備已經使用超過一年
D. 供應商提出新的報價
explain: unless 表示除非。只有第二次檢查確認設備有故障，公司才會更換。

point: warranty distinction between parts and labor
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，保固第一年過後哪項費用需要另外支付？
speak: The warranty covers parts, but labor charges are billed separately after the first year.
explain: 保固涵蓋零件，但第一年之後的維修人工費需另外計算。

desc: 請唸出這句：Please clarify the assumptions behind your estimate.
ans: PLEASE CLARIFY THE ASSUMPTIONS BEHIND YOUR ESTIMATE
speak: please clarify the assumptions behind your estimate

desc: 請唸出這句：The updated schedule depends on supplier approval.
ans: THE UPDATED SCHEDULE DEPENDS ON SUPPLIER APPROVAL
speak: the updated schedule depends on supplier approval

point: expressing the need for further evaluation
desc: 請唸出這句：The proposal requires further evaluation.
speak: the proposal requires further evaluation

desc: 請唸出這句：Despite the delay, we met our target.
ans: DESPITE THE DELAY WE MET OUR TARGET
speak: despite the delay we met our target

desc: 請拼出：可行的
speak: feasible

desc: 請拼出：維護（名詞）
speak: maintenance

desc: 填空題：C O N S I S T E _ T (一致的)
speak: consistent

desc: 填空題：C O M P L I A N _ E (合規)
speak: compliance

desc: Not until the final audit ___ the extent of the financial discrepancies.
explain: Not until 放在句首時，主句需使用部分倒裝。過去式的正確結構是 did + 主詞 + 原形動詞。

point: mixed conditional past cause present result
desc: If she had accepted the overseas position three years ago, she ___ in Singapore now instead of working in London.
explain: 這是混合條件句，過去未發生的選擇造成現在的不同結果。If + had + 過去分詞搭配 would be working，表示現在可能正在新加坡工作。

desc: The report stops short of endorsing the proposal. It merely acknowledges that the preliminary data are encouraging. Which interpretation best reflects the report's position?
options: A. It recognizes positive signs without formally supporting the proposal.
B. It fully recommends implementing the proposal immediately.
C. It rejects the proposal because the data are unreliable.
D. It confirms that the proposal has already achieved its goals.
explain: stops short of endorsing 表示尚未正式表態支持；merely acknowledges 表示僅承認初步數據具有正面跡象。

point: notwithstanding for concession despite prior claims
desc: The panel agreed to delay publication, ___ its earlier insistence that the findings were ready for release.
explain: notwithstanding 表示儘管、不顧。委員會原本堅稱結果可以公布，最後卻同意延後，形成讓步與對比。

desc: The company's expansion strategy was ___ on the assumption that consumer demand would remain stable. When sales collapsed, the strategy became unsustainable.
explain: be predicated on 表示以某項前提或假設為基礎。公司的擴張策略建立在需求穩定的假設之上。

desc: The minister stated, 'There is, at present, insufficient evidence to rule out additional measures.' What does this statement imply?
options: A. Additional measures have been permanently rejected.
B. The existing measures have already been withdrawn.
C. New measures will definitely be announced immediately.
D. Further measures remain possible because the evidence is inconclusive.
explain: insufficient evidence to rule out 表示證據不足以排除某種可能，因此仍可能採取進一步措施，但尚未確定。

point: recognizing confounding factors in causal claims
desc: Several cities reported lower congestion after introducing bike lanes. However, fuel prices increased sharply during the same period, and no comparison cities were studied. What weakens the claim that bike lanes caused the reduction?
options: A. Other simultaneous changes could explain the decline in congestion.
B. The cities did not report any change in congestion.
C. The study demonstrated that fuel prices had no effect.
D. The introduction of bike lanes happened after congestion fell.
explain: 燃油價格同期上升，而且缺少對照城市，因此不能排除其他因素造成壅塞下降。時間上的先後關係不等於因果關係。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，審查者真正質疑的是什麼？
speak: Far from dismissing the findings, the reviewer questioned whether the sample represented the wider population.
options: A. 研究完全沒有發現
B. 樣本是否能代表更廣泛的人口
C. 研究人員是否具有正式資格
D. 研究結果是否已經公開發表
explain: Far from dismissing 表示並非否定研究發現，審查者真正質疑的是樣本對整體人口的代表性。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，補助審查委員會目前的態度是什麼？
speak: A: Will the grant be renewed? B: The panel was impressed, though it stopped short of making a commitment.
options: A. 已經正式拒絕續撥補助
B. 已經核准全部補助金額
C. 印象正面，但尚未承諾續撥
D. 要求申請人立即撤回計畫
explain: was impressed 表示印象良好，但 stopped short of making a commitment 表示尚未做出正式承諾。

point: counterfactual regulatory notification and public reaction
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，說話的人認為較早通報可能帶來什麼結果？
speak: Had the regulators been informed sooner, the recall might have been handled without attracting so much public concern.
options: A. 可以完全避免任何產品召回
B. 監管機關就不需要介入
C. 產品的品質問題會自動消失
D. 召回事件可能不會引起這麼大的公眾疑慮
explain: Had the regulators been informed sooner 是過去反事實假設，might have been handled 表示較早通報或許能減少公眾的擔憂。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，說話的人接受新制度的前提是什麼？
speak: The new framework is sound in principle, provided its safeguards are enforced consistently rather than selectively.
options: A. 保護措施必須一致執行，不能選擇性適用
B. 制度必須完全取消所有監督程序
C. 保護措施只需要適用於少數部門
D. 制度應該先停止所有既有服務
explain: sound in principle 表示原則上合理，但前提是保護措施必須被一致執行，而不是選擇性適用。

point: distinguishing deferred maintenance from efficiency gains
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，說話的人認為節省成本的真正來源是什麼？
speak: I don't dispute the savings, but they came largely from postponing maintenance rather than improving efficiency.
options: A. 成功改善生產效率
B. 延後必要的維護工作
C. 降低原料採購價格
D. 重新分配工作人員
explain: 說話者不否認成本確實降低，但指出節省主要來自延後維護，而非真正提高效率。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，證詞存在什麼問題？
speak: The testimony was persuasive, albeit inconsistent with documents submitted earlier.
options: A. 證詞完全無法理解
B. 證詞缺少任何相關細節
C. 證詞有說服力，卻與先前提交的文件不一致
D. 證詞與所有先前文件完全吻合
explain: albeit 表示雖然、儘管。證詞看似有說服力，但內容與先前提交的文件存在矛盾。

point: reconsideration driven by changing legal context
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，為什麼主席建議重新審議決定？
speak: The chair suggested revisiting the decision, not because the evidence had weakened, but because the legal context had shifted.
options: A. 原本的證據已遭到推翻
B. 委員會成員全部更換
C. 決定已經被正式撤銷
D. 相關法律環境發生了變化
explain: 主席建議重新審議不是因為證據變弱，而是因為相關法律情勢已經改變。

desc: 請唸出這句：The findings warrant a more cautious interpretation.
ans: THE FINDINGS WARRANT A MORE CAUTIOUS INTERPRETATION
speak: the findings warrant a more cautious interpretation

desc: 請唸出這句：His explanation was compelling but ultimately inconclusive.
ans: HIS EXPLANATION WAS COMPELLING BUT ULTIMATELY INCONCLUSIVE
speak: his explanation was compelling but ultimately inconclusive

desc: 請唸出這句：We cannot overlook the broader implications.
ans: WE CANNOT OVERLOOK THE BROADER IMPLICATIONS
speak: we cannot overlook the broader implications

desc: 請唸出這句：The policy should be implemented consistently across departments.
ans: THE POLICY SHOULD BE IMPLEMENTED CONSISTENTLY ACROSS DEPARTMENTS
speak: the policy should be implemented consistently across departments

desc: 請拼出：模稜兩可的
speak: ambiguous

desc: 請拼出：連貫性
speak: coherence

desc: 填空題：I N T E R P R E T A _ I O N (詮釋)
speak: interpretation

desc: 填空題：R E P E R C U S S _ O N S (後果)
speak: repercussions

desc: Had the archive been digitized earlier, researchers ___ to rely on damaged originals during last year's investigation.
explain: Had the archive been digitized earlier 是省略 if 的第三類條件句，表示與過去事實相反的假設。主句使用 would not have had to，表示研究人員當時本來就不必依賴受損原件。

desc: The ethics panel recommended that every participant ___ informed of the potential risks before signing.
explain: recommend that 後面可使用要求型虛擬語氣，動詞維持原形。be informed 是被動結構，表示每位參與者都應事先被告知潛在風險。

desc: To concede that the report is incomplete is not to suggest that its findings are worthless. Several conclusions remain useful, provided their limitations are acknowledged. Which interpretation best reflects the author's position?
options: A. An incomplete report should be rejected in its entirety.
B. The report's limitations are too minor to mention.
C. Acknowledging limitations does not automatically invalidate the findings.
D. The findings are valuable only if every conclusion is proven beyond doubt.
explain: 作者承認報告不完整，但不認為這等於研究發現毫無價值。核心在於區分承認缺陷與全面否定，並要求解讀時考慮限制。

desc: Asked whether the government would introduce the proposed restrictions, the minister replied, 'We have no current plans to do so.' Which conclusion is most justified?
options: A. The government has permanently ruled out the restrictions.
B. The restrictions have already been approved.
C. The minister has promised to oppose the restrictions under all circumstances.
D. The government is not planning the restrictions now, but its position could change.
explain: no current plans 只表示目前沒有相關計畫，並未作出永久承諾。current 是關鍵限定詞，因此未來立場仍可能改變。

point: distinguishing conciliatory language from genuine contrition
desc: Her apology was less an acknowledgment of wrongdoing than an attempt to bring the discussion to an end. The statement avoided addressing the specific allegations. What does the author imply?
options: A. The apology primarily sought to end the dispute rather than accept responsibility.
B. The apology provided a detailed admission of every allegation.
C. The speaker had already been cleared of all wrongdoing.
D. The apology demonstrated genuine remorse through specific corrective actions.
explain: less an acknowledgment of wrongdoing than an attempt to bring the discussion to an end 表示道歉主要是為了結束爭論，而非承認錯誤。作者對道歉的誠意抱持懷疑。

desc: The chair tried to ___ employees' fears about restructuring, stressing that no immediate layoffs were planned.
explain: allay fears 表示減輕或平息恐懼。主席強調沒有立即裁員的計畫，目的是讓員工安心。其他三個選項都帶有加劇負面情緒的意思。

point: little more than as dismissive evaluation
desc: The revised strategy amounts to little more than a cosmetic change. Its presentation has improved, but the underlying assumptions remain untouched. What is the author's main criticism?
options: A. The new strategy is more expensive than the previous version.
B. The underlying assumptions have been thoroughly reconsidered.
C. The revisions are largely superficial rather than substantive.
D. The strategy has been abandoned in favor of an entirely new approach.
explain: little more than a cosmetic change 表示只不過是表面上的修改。作者認為呈現方式雖有改善，但根本假設沒有改變，因此改革缺乏實質內容。

point: questioning long term conclusions from short term gains
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，說話的人對哪個推論抱持保留態度？
speak: With all due respect, I'd hesitate to call a short-term improvement evidence of a lasting recovery.
options: A. 短期數據是否真的出現改善
B. 資料是否經過蓄意偽造
C. 評論者是否有資格發表意見
D. 短期改善是否足以證明長期復甦
explain: With all due respect 是禮貌表達不同意見的方式。說話者不否認短期改善，而是質疑短期表現能否作為長期復甦的證據。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，第二位說話者對合併案的立場是什麼？
speak: A: Are you endorsing the merger? B: I'm not opposing it outright, but I won't sign off without independent due diligence.
options: A. 不完全反對，但完成獨立盡職調查前不會批准
B. 已經正式支持合併，無須額外調查
C. 原則上反對所有企業合併
D. 願意批准，但要求調整合併後的公司名稱
explain: not opposing it outright 表示沒有完全反對，但 won't sign off without independent due diligence 表示在完成獨立盡職調查前不會正式批准。

point: technically accurate yet contextually misleading information
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，說話者認為公布的數據有什麼問題？
speak: The revised figures are technically accurate, though presenting them without last year's context could give investors the wrong impression.
options: A. 所有數據都經過不當修改
B. 數據本身正確，但缺少背景可能誤導投資人
C. 去年的數據比今年更不可靠
D. 投資人已經掌握所有必要資訊
explain: technically accurate 表示數據本身在技術上正確，但缺少去年背景資訊，仍可能使投資人形成錯誤印象。

desc: 🎧 聽一聽，說話者如何解讀她在會議中的沉默？
speak: I wouldn't characterize her silence as agreement; she may simply have felt that challenging the chair was futile.
options: A. 她已經完全接受主席的觀點
B. 她沒有聽懂會議內容
C. 她可能覺得反對主席也沒有用，沉默不代表同意
D. 她打算在會議結束後正式辭職
explain: 說話者不認為沉默等於同意，反而推測她可能認為挑戰主席徒勞無功，因此選擇不發言。

point: reframing policy failure as insufficient time
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，發言人如何重新解釋政策表現不佳？
speak: Rather than concede the policy had failed, the spokesperson framed the poor results as evidence that more time was needed.
options: A. 承認政策失敗並立即宣布撤回
B. 將表現不佳歸因於執行人員不足
C. 宣稱政策成果已經全面超越預期
D. 把不佳結果解釋為政策還需要更多時間
explain: Rather than concede 表示沒有承認失敗，而 framed ... as 表示將不佳結果重新詮釋為需要更多時間的證據。

point: prioritizing audited evidence over optimistic projections
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，什麼證據更能說服說話者？
speak: The board's confidence is reassuring, but I'd be more persuaded by audited accounts than by another optimistic forecast.
options: A. 經過正式查核的財務報表
B. 董事會對未來的樂觀預測
C. 管理階層公開表達的信心
D. 尚未經過驗證的成長估計
explain: 說話者認為董事會的信心雖然令人安心，但相比另一份樂觀預測，經過查核的財務報表更具有說服力。

point: not so much as contrast identifying primary grievance
desc: 🎧 聽一聽，真正讓員工不滿的是什麼？
speak: It wasn't so much the decision itself that upset staff as the fact that they learned about it from the press.
options: A. 公司做出的決定本身
B. 員工竟然是從媒體得知這項決定
C. 媒體報導中的數字不正確
D. 公司要求員工接受額外訓練
explain: not so much A as B 用來強調真正的重點是 B。員工主要不滿的是公司的溝通方式，而非決定本身。
